## Mission & Educational Philosophy
Nth Dimension Academy bridges the gap between theoretical cloud certifications and high-scale enterprise production. Founded by an active Microsoft Certified Trainer with 14+ years designing multi-terabyte data solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises, the curriculum employs interactive 3D concept modeling, hands-on labs, and real-world medallion architecture patterns.

## Comprehensive Certification Programs & Timelines

### 1. DP-700: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric (Flagship Masterclass)
- **Target Role**: Fabric Data Engineer, Cloud Platform Engineer, Big Data Architect
- **Credential**: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (Exam DP-700)
- **Duration**: **35 Days** (7 Calendar Weeks)
- **Total Hours**: **70 Total Hours** (35h Live Lectures + 35h Hands-on Sandbox Labs)
- **Delivery Format**: Weekday (Mon–Fri, 2 hrs/day) or Weekend Batch (Sat–Sun, 5 hrs/day)
- **URL**: https://nthdimensionacademy.com/dp700-atlas/
- **Core Competencies**:
  - Plan, implement, and manage an enterprise analytics environment (30–35%)
  - Ingest, clean, and transform data using PySpark and Data Factory pipelines (30–35%)
  - Monitor, secure, and optimize storage, capacity, and query performance (30–35%)
- **Timeline Progression**:
  - Week 1 (Days 1–5): Tenant, Workspace Administration, OneLake Shortcuts & Security Governance (LAB 01)
  - Week 2 (Days 6–10): Lakehouse Architecture, Delta Parquet Internals & Medallion Strategy (LAB 02)
  - Week 3 (Days 11–15): High-Scale Ingestion, Dataflows Gen2 & Zero-ETL Database Mirroring (LAB 03 & 04)
  - Week 4 (Days 16–20): Advanced PySpark Distributed Transformations & Spark Optimization (LAB 05)
  - Week 5 (Days 21–25): Delta Lake Performance Tuning (OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER, VACUUM) & Time Travel (LAB 06)
  - Week 6 (Days 26–30): Synapse Data Warehouse Engineering & Real-Time Eventstream/KQL Analytics (LAB 07)
  - Week 7 (Days 31–35): Azure DevOps CI/CD Git Release Pipelines, Purview Lineage & DP-700 Exam Marathon (LAB 08)

### 2. DP-600: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
- **Target Role**: Fabric Analytics Engineer, BI Architect, Power BI Specialist
- **Credential**: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (Exam DP-600)
- **Duration**: **30 Days** (6 Calendar Weeks)
- **Total Hours**: **60 Total Hours** (30h Live Lectures + 30h Hands-on Sandbox Labs)
- **Delivery Format**: Weekday (Mon–Fri, 2 hrs/day) or Weekend Batch (Sat–Sun, 5 hrs/day)
- **URL**: https://nthdimensionacademy.com/dp600-atlas/
- **Core Competencies**:
  - Plan, implement, and manage an analytics environment (10–15%)
  - Prepare and serve data via Dataflows Gen2 and SQL Analytics Endpoints (40–45%)
  - Implement and manage semantic models and advanced DAX calculations (25–30%)
  - Explore and analyze data using Power BI Direct Lake mode (20–25%)
- **Timeline Progression**:
  - Week 1 (Days 1–5): Analytics Environment, Workspace Permissions & OneLake Architecture (LAB 01)
  - Week 2 (Days 6–10): Data Preparation, Cleansing with Dataflows Gen2 & Dimension Staging (LAB 02)
  - Week 3 (Days 11–15): T-SQL Analytics on Lakehouses, SQL Endpoints & Notebook Transformations (LAB 03)
  - Week 4 (Days 16–20): Enterprise Semantic Modeling, Star Schema & Advanced DAX Calculations (LAB 04)
  - Week 5 (Days 21–25): Power BI Direct Lake Zero-Copy Mode & DAX Performance Optimization (LAB 05)
  - Week 6 (Days 26–30): PBIP Git Source Control, Purview Data Governance & DP-600 Mock Exam (LAB 06)

### 3. DP-750: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Azure Databricks
- **Target Role**: Databricks Data Engineer, Lakehouse Platform Engineer
- **Credential**: Microsoft Certified: Azure Databricks Data Engineer (Exam DP-750)
- **Duration**: **30 Days** (6 Calendar Weeks)
- **Total Hours**: **60 Total Hours** (30h Live Lectures + 30h Hands-on Labs)
- **Delivery Format**: Weekday (Mon–Fri, 2 hrs/day) or Weekend Batch (Sat–Sun, 5 hrs/day)
- **URL**: https://nthdimensionacademy.com/dp750-atlas/
- **Core Competencies**:
  - Architect Azure Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog governance (30–35%)
  - Build streaming and batch ETL pipelines using Delta Live Tables (25–30%)
  - Optimize PySpark jobs, memory caching, Liquid Clustering, and shuffle partitions (20–25%)
  - Secure data assets with fine-grained access control, column masking & lineage (15–20%)
- **Timeline Progression**:
  - Week 1 (Days 1–5): Databricks Workspaces & Unity Catalog 3-Level Namespace Architecture (LAB 01)
  - Week 2 (Days 6–10): Delta Lake Internals, ACID Logging & Bronze-to-Gold Architecture (LAB 02)
  - Week 3 (Days 11–15): Delta Live Tables (DLT) Declarative Pipelines & Auto Loader Ingestion (LAB 03)
  - Week 4 (Days 16–20): PySpark Tuning, Photon Engine, Shuffle Elimination & Liquid Clustering (LAB 04)
  - Week 5 (Days 21–25): Dynamic Column Masking, Row-Level Security & Purview Catalog Integration (LAB 05)
  - Week 6 (Days 26–30): Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), CI/CD Production Workflows & DP-750 Exam Drills (LAB 06)

### 4. DP-800: Implementing a Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse
- **Target Role**: Data Warehouse Architect, Enterprise Analytics Engineer, SQL Specialist
- **Credential**: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Warehouse Specialist (Exam DP-800)
- **Duration**: **25 Days** (5 Calendar Weeks)
- **Total Hours**: **50 Total Hours** (25h Live Lectures + 25h Practical Labs)
- **Delivery Format**: Weekday (Mon–Fri, 2 hrs/day) or Weekend Batch (Sat–Sun, 5 hrs/day)
- **URL**: https://nthdimensionacademy.com/dp800-atlas/
- **Core Competencies**:
  - Architect and deploy scalable Fabric Data Warehouses (25–30%)
  - Write high-performance T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and transactions (30–35%)
  - Implement dimensional modeling (Star/Snowflake, SCD Type 1 & 2) (20–25%)
  - Migrate legacy Synapse Dedicated SQL Pools and on-prem SQL Server to Fabric (15–20%)
- **Timeline Progression**:
  - Week 1 (Days 1–5): Fabric Synapse Warehouse Architecture & Decoupled Storage Provisioning (LAB 01)
  - Week 2 (Days 6–10): Dimensional Modeling & Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD 1/2) with T-SQL (LAB 02)
  - Week 3 (Days 11–15): High-Performance T-SQL Stored Procedures & OneLake Delta Compaction (LAB 03)
  - Week 4 (Days 16–20): Legacy Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool Migration & CTAS Conversion (LAB 04)
  - Week 5 (Days 21–25): Query Insights DMVs, Security (RLS/CLS/OLS) & DP-800 Exam Marathon (LAB 05)
